You breathe out, catch the line of your opponent’s movement with an open hand, and strike while guiding their weight past you.

Rules

Action

No item needed unless named above.

Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type

Strike with an empty hand, foot or shoulder. You read balance, not anatomy alone.

3 physical damage.
Standard
3 physical damage and push 1 square.

5 physical damage and push 2 squares.
